title: 737. Count Different Palindromic Subsequences

examples.explanation: Six distinct palindromes: b, c, bb, cc, bcb, bccb.
Four repeats of abcd yield 244 distinct palindromic letter sequences.

hints: Let dp[l][r] be the answer for the slice s[l..r]; grow the slice from short to long.
When the ends match, the inner answer doubles, then adjust using the next matching positions inside to avoid double counting.
When the ends differ, combine dp[l+1][r] and dp[l][r-1] and subtract dp[l+1][r-1]; keep everything modulo 1000000007.
